replay_policy: Reuse the previous reference_run/report/selected_cases.json VALIDATION case; do not select a new favorable case using new scores
history_policy: At 0.5s stride, encode three non-overlapping 2s gyro windows ending 4s/2s/0s before now; at startup retain available windows, no extra wait. Reset on record change or missing 0.5s step. Tensor padding excluded by explicit packed lengths; no raw-sensor imputation.
outer_folds: Reuse frozen TRAIN14 diagnostic participant folds from reference_run/train_oof_rf_context/folds.json
checkpoint_policy: Within each outer TRAIN only, one stratified participant split (stratum=any FoG window). Fit/checkpoint people disjoint; restore min-loss epoch, reinitialize and fit all outer TRAIN for that many epochs before scoring held-out people.
deployment_epoch_policy: Median of three TRAIN-only inner best epochs, then random initialization and fit all TRAIN14 for fixed epochs. No VALIDATION checkpoint or refit.
threshold_policy: TRAIN pooled OOF F1, balanced accuracy, higher threshold. OOF selection metrics are calibration/development, not independent test scores. Freeze model and threshold before VALIDATION.

architecture.encoder: Existing independently implemented author CNN conv16/16/24/24 k9/7/5/5 and GAP24
architecture.head: Dense48 ReLU, dropout0.4, one FoG logit
architecture.kernel_regularization: four conv kernels and Dense48 only; no GRU or output kernel penalty beyond optimizer decay

development_success_gate: On same VALIDATION windows: GRU F1 strictly higher, false alarm seconds no higher, freezing-time recall no lower than freshly retrained CNN control. Even a pass does not auto-replace the default or establish external generalization.
test_policy: No new candidate TEST windows or scores. VALIDATION is an already inspected development cohort; no new blind-test claim.
search_budget: Two architectures, one declared optimizer setting, one seed per fold. No augmentation, activity gate/head, threshold budget, seed retries, posthoc retuning or default/controller changes.
